title: Chapter 92: Request
html:
The sight surprised even Chen Ge, the Haunted House’s owner. Mu Yang High School dwarfed Murder by Midnight. As he stepped inside, a cold draft brushed the back of his neck, leaving him with the uneasy sense that something might leap from the darkness at any moment.

Four classrooms, corridors, toilets, and offices…

Everything from Mu Yang High School had been faithfully replicated, though the layout had been compressed to bring each area closer together.

As Chen Ge walked down the dim corridor, he kept glancing into the classrooms on either side. Solid concrete lay beyond the windows, and no draft should have existed underground, yet the panes creaked as if stirred by wind.

The first few classrooms were unsettling but tolerable. When he reached the sealed classroom at the corridor’s end, however, every hair on his body rose. Never before had he felt such intense fear inside his own Haunted House.

The room resembled the sealed classroom at Mu Yang High School, but the reproduction was not exact. Red writing covered every desk, and more disturbingly, a school uniform sat on each chair.

The uniforms perfectly matched those in Fan Yu’s father’s group photograph. In the picture, every student faced away from the camera. Here, every empty uniform faced Chen Ge at the door.

He drew a deep breath and forced himself inside. From the lectern, the rows of chairs looked as though invisible students occupied them.

Why did only this classroom come with uniforms? Do they represent the lingering spirits that remained here?Chen Ge counted them in silence. There were twenty-four.

After I completed the Murder by Midnight Trial Mission, that scenario became the new home of Xiaoxiao’s family. If the same logic applies here…His face twitched. Twenty-four lingering spirits had just moved into his Haunted House.

Then again, I could be wrong.Chen Ge left the classroom, shut the door, and continued onward.

The restroom stood at the corridor’s end. A few steps beyond it lay the first junction: the office area to the left and the girls’ dormitory to the right.

Chen Ge turned right. Within a few steps, the corridor narrowed. Rooms pressed in from both sides, and another junction waited at the far end.

Just a two-star scenario is already so complicated. If I unlock a few more scenarios, this underground parking lot will definitely become a Maze of Terror.

He pushed open a random door, and the interior was designed like a crime scene.

In the second-to-last bedroom, a row of chairs stood side by side. Several sheets of paper and a badly damaged ballpoint pen lay on one seat.

Is this the hidden item from unlocking Mu Yang High School?Chen Ge lifted the pen with care. It looked fragile enough to crumble at a touch. Hidden items always seem to have a purpose. Wang Qi’s Missing Person Notice helped me befriend Xiaoxiao’s family, and now they help maintain Murder by Midnight. Could this pen help me win over the students in the sealed classroom?

He could not see how. In the end, he left the scenario with the pen and returned to the staff breakroom to repair it with tape.

“Pen Spirit, Pen Spirit, I know you hold a grudge against me, but I’ve fixed your pen. If you have forgiven me, please draw a circle on the paper.”

“Pen Spirit, Pen Spirit, you are my spirit from my previous life, and I am your spirit in this life. If you are with us, please draw a circle on the paper…”

Asking the Pen Spirit was the most direct way to solve the mystery of the sealed classroom. No matter how many times Chen Ge repeated the invocation, however, it refused to answer.

“Why so silent? I’m also a victim in this case, okay?”

With no other choice, Chen Ge returned the pen to the girls’ dormitory. He made another circuit of the scenario, then went back upstairs.

The twenty-four uniforms in the sealed classroom are frightening, but they lack impact. When I have time, I should refurbish the mannequins from Night of the Living Dead, dress them in the uniforms, and place them in the classroom. That should raise the fear factor.Chen Ge replaced the wooden boards and was about to return to bed when his phone rang.

To his surprise, Inspector Lee was calling.

“Uncle San Bao? How can I help you?” When Chen Ge returned from Mu Yang High School, Inspector Lee had stayed. He seemed to have been talking with the officers from the main city’s investigation team.

“If you’re not too busy, do you mind coming to the district police station? The killer wants to talk to you.”

“Me?” Though confused, Chen Ge agreed out of respect for Inspector Lee. “All right. I’ll be there soon.”

When he arrived, a familiar officer led Chen Ge to the interrogation room. Fan Yu’s aunt was sitting in the chair, her hands in cuffs.

“The autopsies are still underway. The suspect is emotionally unstable and refuses to speak. Her only demand was to see you in person, which is why we called.” The middle-aged officer rose and shook Chen Ge’s hand. “We’ll leave her to you.”

“I’ll do my best.” Chen Ge approached Fan Yu’s aunt. In a single night, she seemed to have aged. Her head hung low, her hair covering her face.

Sensing his approach, her distracted gaze slowly focused on him. Complicated emotions moved through her eyes.

“You asked for me?” When Chen Ge approached, the officer stopped him at a safe distance.

Fan Yu’s aunt nodded slightly. A long silence passed before she surprised him with her first question. “Do you have the drawing I gave you in the third-floor restroom?”

Had she not mentioned it, Chen Ge would have forgotten. He took the drawing from his pocket and set it before her. Rather than fear the strange image, she regarded it like a treasure. That was understandable; after her husband and children died, Fan Yu’s drawings had gradually drawn her out of despair.

At last, she spoke. “For three years, I did everything I could for Fan Yu. Yet the first living person to appear in one of his drawings was you. How is that fair?”

“It might not be what you think. Fan Yu probably sees us as alike.” Chen Ge pointed to his eyes. “We can see the same things.”

“Is that so?” Fan Yu’s aunt lowered her head again, and the interrogation room became quiet.

“Is this why you called me here?” Chen Ge folded the drawing up neatly.

Ten minutes passed before Fan Yu’s aunt composed herself, as if reaching a decision. “I am Fan Yu’s only remaining family, and soon I’ll have to leave him. He is a strange boy and cannot make friends. I’m not asking you to take responsibility for him. I only beg you to visit when you can. Talk to him, and make sure the other children don’t bully him.”
